item.title: Big & Rich’s John Rich Sworn In as USDA Special Envoy for American Landowners: ‘Let’s Get to Work’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment and beyond. Today, we're shining the spotlight on country star John Rich, who's just been sworn in as the Special Envoy for American Landowners. Let's dive into the details."
[Music transitions to a neutral background tune]
Host: "According to a White House social media post on Friday, July 10th, John Rich was officially sworn in by President Donald Trump in the Oval Office. The ceremony was attended by Rich's family, and the Big & Rich member even got to shake hands with the President."
[Short music break]
Host: "Rich himself took to social media to express his gratitude, saying 'Today, I'll be sworn in as Special Envoy for American Landowners by President Trump at the Oval. My family will be there with me!' He also thanked the President for the opportunity to fight for his fellow Americans."
[Music continues in the background]
Host: "But what does this new role mean for John Rich? According to the USDA, he'll be engaging with and advocating for farmers, ranchers, and private landowners across the country. His focus will be on addressing challenges posed by government overreach and outside interests that threaten private property rights and rural communities."
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: "Rich has been a champion for rural America and has even used his music to express his feelings on government overreach. Remember his song 'The Devil & The TVA' from last September? It criticized the Tennessee Valley Authority's plan to build a methane gas facility in Tennessee's Cheatham County."
[Music continues]
Host: "As Special Envoy for American Landowners, John Rich is ready to get to work. He quote-tweeted the White House post, saying 'Let's get to work' alongside an American flag emoji. We'll be keeping an eye on his progress and seeing how he makes a difference in the lives of American landowners."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for joining us on this podcast. If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest news and updates, be sure to follow us on social media. Until next time, goodbye!"
